images.caption: MUNITIONS MANUFACTURING IS NO RESPECTER OF AGE.  Many of the women of France who are doing their bit in the production of large-caliber shells for the big guns at the front have completed their allotted threescore years and ten, yet they gladly give the closing days of their lives "for France."  In many cases their labor is all that they have left to give, for grandsons, sons, and husbands already have been sacrificed on the firing line.

images.caption: The Exposition Internationale des Arts et Techniques dans la Vie Moderne was held from 25 May to 25 November 1937 in Paris, France. This Agfacolor photo made by Dutch couple from Den Haag on car journey was not colorized. There are only four photos from this city by them and two duplicates of fountain with slightly different time.
